records.jp: おー、ユズさんがいる
records.en_original: Oh, hey Yuzu.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, hey Yuzu.
records.en: Oh, Yuzu-san is here.

records.jp: なに
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: いや、こうして一ヵ所にとどまってるのは<CR>珍しいなと思って
records.en_original: Nothing, I was just thinking how rare it is for you to stay in one place.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing, I was just thinking how rare it is for you to stay in one place.
records.en: It's rare to see you<CR>staying in one place like this.

records.jp: 協力することになったから
records.en_original: It's because I am now working with you.
records.en_auxiliary: It's because I am now working with you.
records.en: Because we agreed to cooperate.

records.jp: それで、何か聞きたいことでもあるの？
records.en_original: Well, was there something you wanted to ask me?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, was there something you wanted to ask me?
records.en: So, did you want to ask me something?

records.jp: この世界はシェルター……なんだよね。<CR>灰か何かから私たちを守るための
records.en_original: So, this world is a shelter keeping us safe from the Ash and whatnot, right?
records.en_auxiliary: So, this world is a shelter keeping us safe from the Ash and whatnot, right?
records.en: This world is a shelter, right?<CR>To protect us from the Ash or something.

records.jp: そのはず。<CR>私も記憶を失っているから、定かではないけど
records.en_original: I believe so. But as I have lost my memory, we have no way of knowing for sure.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe so. But as I have lost my memory, we have no way of knowing for sure.
records.en: It should be.<CR>But I lost my memories too, so I'm not certain.

records.jp: そもそもリフレクターって何なの？
records.en_original: What exactly is a Reflector in the first place?
records.en_auxiliary: What exactly is a Reflector in the first place?
records.en: What exactly is a Reflector in the first place?

records.jp: ……一言で説明するのは難しい。<CR>覚えていない部分もあるから
records.en_original: ...That's difficult to answer. There are some things that I can't remember.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That's difficult to answer. There are some things that I can't remember.
records.en: It's hard to sum up in one sentence.<CR>There are parts I don't remember.

records.jp: でも、強いて言うなら……
records.en_original: But if you had to say...
records.en_auxiliary: But if you had to say...
records.en: But if I had to...

records.jp: 自らの想いを武器に、人々の想いを守る人たち。<CR>それだけがわかっていれば、問題ない
records.en_original: They wield their feelings as weapons to protect others. That is the main thing you need to know.
records.en_auxiliary: They wield their feelings as weapons to protect others. That is the main thing you need to know.
records.en: People who wield their own feelings as weapons<CR>to protect the feelings of others. That's all you need to know.

records.jp: この世界にいる人はみんなリフレクターなの？<CR>勇希は力を使えないみたいだけど
records.en_original: So, are all the people in this world Reflectors? Yuki doesn't seem to be able to use any powers...
records.en_auxiliary: So, are all the people in this world Reflectors? Yuki doesn't seem to be able to use any powers...
records.en: Is everyone in this world a Reflector?<CR>Yuki can't seem to use her power.

records.jp: そのはず。彼女が力を使えないのは……<CR>きっと別の理由がある
records.en_original: I should think so. There must be a reason that she can't use any powers...
records.en_auxiliary: I should think so. There must be a reason that she can't use any powers...
records.en: They should be.<CR>There must be another reason she can't use hers.

records.jp: ……他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: ひとまずは、まだ合流できていないリフレクターを<CR>見つけ出せばいいんだよね
records.en_original: First, you should find the remaining Reflectors and bring them here.
records.en_auxiliary: First, you should find the remaining Reflectors and bring them here.
records.en: For now, we need to find<CR>the Reflectors who haven't joined us yet, right?

records.jp: そして、みんなの記憶を取り戻すことで、<CR>外の世界の状態を明らかにする
records.en_original: Then, by recovering everyone's memories, you can figure out what is happening in the outside world.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, by recovering everyone's memories, you can figure out what is happening in the outside world.
records.en: And by restoring everyone's memories,<CR>we can discover the state of the outside world.

records.jp: 外に出られることがわかれば、<CR>ライムがこの世界を管理する必要もなくなるから
records.en_original: Once we know we are able to go outside, Lime will no longer have to sustain this world.
records.en_auxiliary: Once we know we are able to go outside, Lime will no longer have to sustain this world.
records.en: If we learn that we can leave,<CR>Lime will no longer need to manage this world.

records.jp: 早くライムさんを解放してあげないと……
records.en_original: We've got to free Lime as soon as we can...
records.en_auxiliary: We've got to free Lime as soon as we can...
records.en: We have to free Lime-san soon...

records.jp: それにしても、リフレクターを呼び出すために<CR>想いが重なるものを作る、かあ
records.en_original: So to summon the Reflectors, we need to make things that they have emotional attachments to?
records.en_auxiliary: So to summon the Reflectors, we need to make things that they have emotional attachments to?
records.en: Still, making an object that resonates with their feelings<CR>to summon a Reflector, huh...

records.jp: （離れていても心はすぐそばに……とはよく聞くけど、<CR>それがこの世界では現実になるってことかな……？）
records.en_original: (I've heard that hearts can be connected even across distances... Is that how this world works?)
records.en_auxiliary: (I've heard that hearts can be connected even across distances... Is that how this world works?)
records.en: (People say hearts stay close even when they're apart,<CR>but does that actually become reality in this world...?)

records.jp: 他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: ユズさんのことが知りたいな
records.en_original: Could you tell me about yourself?
records.en_auxiliary: Could you tell me about yourself?
records.en: I want to know about you, Yuzu-san.

records.jp: 私はもともとコモンの管理者で……
records.en_original: I used to watch over the Common, and—
records.en_auxiliary: I used to watch over the Common, and—
records.en: I was originally an administrator of the Common, and—

records.jp: あーいや、そういうことじゃなくて……。<CR>何が好きだとか、趣味はこれですとか
records.en_original: No, no! I'm not talking about that stuff. I want to know about your hobbies, what you like...
records.en_auxiliary: No, no! I'm not talking about that stuff. I want to know about your hobbies, what you like...
records.en: No, not that.<CR>I mean what you like, your hobbies...

records.jp: そんなこと聞いてどうするの？
records.en_original: What would you do with that information?
records.en_auxiliary: What would you do with that information?
records.en: Why do you want to know?

records.jp: え？　仲良くなれたらなー、なんて……
records.en_original: Huh? Well, I thought it might help us get along better...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Well, I thought it might help us get along better...
records.en: Huh? I thought... maybe we could become friends...

records.jp: （も、もしかして仲良くなりたくないのかな？）
records.en_original: (M-maybe she doesn't want to be friends?)
records.en_auxiliary: (M-maybe she doesn't want to be friends?)
records.en: (D-does she not want to be friends?)

records.jp: ……ごめん、覚えてないの
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry. I don't remember.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry. I don't remember.
records.en: ...Sorry. I don't remember.

records.jp: そ、そっか
records.en_original: A-ah, I see...
records.en_auxiliary: A-ah, I see...
records.en: A-ah, I see...

records.jp: クレープは好きなの？
records.en_original: Do you like crepes?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you like crepes?
records.en: Do you like crepes?

records.jp: あれはまた食べたい
records.en_original: I would like to taste one again.
records.en_auxiliary: I would like to taste one again.
records.en: I want to eat one again.

records.jp: （甘いものは、どうやら好きそうだ）
records.en_original: (She does look like she'd have a sweet tooth.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She does look like she'd have a sweet tooth.)
records.en: (It looks like she does like sweets.)

records.jp: 他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: ううん、大丈夫。<CR>それじゃあ、またね
records.en_original: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
records.en_auxiliary: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
records.en: No, I'm fine.<CR>See you later.
